Disconfirming test that matters is survival at $55 WTI, not cheapness (nothing is cheap). Buyback-at-highs risk checked: unlike SHEL, XOM funds distributions from FCF (positive Q1 FCF), not new debt.

Net-debt-to-cap 13.1% (fortress). 43-year consecutive dividend-growth streak (Dividend Aristocrat) = the household RMW quality-underweight fix. Positive Q1 free cash flow. $20B/yr buyback authorization = the drawdown shock-absorber. C-corp -> 1099 (no K-1).
court_record.why_it_wins: Best quality real-asset carry in the universe: only name that unambiguously ADDS quality (low breakeven + fortress balance sheet + 43-yr aristocrat) rather than cyclical leverage. SHEL failed (debt-funded buybacks, gearing ->23.2%); CVX second (Q1 GAAP FCF negative on working-capital drag, exact net-debt ratio UNVERIFIABLE from primary).

edge_explainer.market_believes: Big Oil is a late-cycle trade after a +31% run; the melt-up is over.
edge_explainer.we_believe: XOM at ~$156 is fair, not cheap -- and fair value IS the entry for a fortress-quality carry name. We are paid ~3% growing dividend + buyback on the lowest-breakeven supermajor, and we own the oil price beta for free. Bought as carry, not edge.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None -- edge_pp=0. RP_FAIR carry: the sleeve's default deploying class. The overlay (if any) is the quality tilt into a household that is underweight quality.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It IS priced in -- +31% YTD, fair multiple. That is the label.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Nothing needs to; carry + dividend accrue. Observables: breakeven guidance, net-debt-to-cap, buyback pace.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A balance sheet that levers up (net-debt-to-cap >20%) or a suspended buyback = the carry thesis broke; trim.
edge_explainer.edge_type: RP_FAIR carry; quality anchor of the energy sleeve
